# The build index opens on how many rules the corpus states, gives each standard under a heading of its id, title and
# status, and each rule by its title alone. It names the lookup skill that survived the trim as the way to read a
# rule's obligations, and quotes none of them.
.dist/plugin/views/build-index.md :: # Rules the standards of example-views state
.dist/plugin/views/build-index.md :: example-views 1.0.0 states 2 rules for code in this repository, under the 2 standards below.
.dist/plugin/views/build-index.md :: The standards-lookup skill returns a rule's obligations by its standard's id.
.dist/plugin/views/build-index.md :: ## std-DEPLOY: An artefact says which change it came from (draft)
.dist/plugin/views/build-index.md :: - The artefact records its commit
.dist/plugin/views/build-index.md :: ## std-OBS: One request reads as one timeline (active)
.dist/plugin/views/build-index.md :: - A call forwards the trace
.dist/plugin/views/build-index.md :: !std-DEPLOY.the-artefact-records-its-commit
.dist/plugin/views/build-index.md :: !Status:
.dist/plugin/views/build-index.md :: !**MUST**

# The build-index hook prints the build index as one line of JSON, as context for the session before a tool runs.
.dist/plugin/hooks/build-index.json :: {"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"# Rules the standards of example-views state\n\n
.dist/plugin/hooks/build-index.json :: - The artefact records its commit\n

# The review view gives each rule's obligations in the standard's own words, under the id to cite. It opens on the
# status a standard is in force at, and on which controls check a rule, stated as facts.
.dist/plugin/views/review.md :: - A standard is in force at status `active`.
.dist/plugin/views/review.md :: A control checks a rule only where its status is `active` and its mechanism is `ci` or `runtime-alert`
.dist/plugin/views/review.md :: !Report
.dist/plugin/views/review.md :: ## std-DEPLOY: An artefact says which change it came from
.dist/plugin/views/review.md :: Status: draft.
.dist/plugin/views/review.md :: Cite as `std-DEPLOY.the-artefact-records-its-commit`.
.dist/plugin/views/review.md :: - An artefact **MUST** record the commit it was built from.
.dist/plugin/views/review.md :: - A service **SHOULD** report that commit on its health endpoint.

# A control listing a standard in `verifies` is stated once, under that standard, with its mechanism. A standard no
# control checks says so.
.dist/plugin/views/review.md :: Controls: `ctl-0002` Nothing checks that a running service reports its commit (`not-enforced`, active).
.dist/plugin/views/review.md :: Controls: none.

# The plugin manifest keeps each view's declaration, as it keeps every component that survived.
.dist/plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json :: "view": "build-index"
.dist/plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json :: "view": "review"
